purpose: Retrospective four-way RTN2 rate ablation on the previously scored ten Msn2 pulse trains. Fit each rate law to the same 16 original training single-pulse schedules only; exclude the 30-minute holdout and all repeated-pulse data from optimization and selection.
rate: Three channel logits have a free intercept. Switch = per-channel offset times 1[normalized measured Msn2 > 0.1]. Neural = original four-hidden-unit tanh correction receiving current tanh(input), upstream memory z and delayed memory h. Remove a term by making its output identically zero; both terms can be active. All laws use 0.05 + 13.95 sigmoid(logit) per hour, applied to both serial filter stages. Preserve all memory across pulses and gaps.
target: Frozen direct + delayed W, target decay, baseline, scaling, measurement grid and per-seed readouts from the two original 2400-update neural-rate fits. Fit only active rate-law parameters for each seed. Equal-source-schedule RTN2 normalized squared error strictly after final removal through minute 120, no penalty. All models get identical outcomes, inputs and loss.
optimizer: For each model and each frozen readout, compare three source-only starts: projected archived rate weights, the original untrained seed initialization, and a 3/hour base with seeded dispersed logit offsets and fresh hidden features. Each gets 2400 full-batch Adam updates, same original cosine learning-rate schedule and clipping. Select smallest final training recovery error; use mean forecasts across readout seeds. No choice uses repeated-pulse responses. Report source loss and sensitivity to seed/start.
endpoint: All ten repeated-pulse schedules, mean per-schedule MSE strictly after final nominal removal to minute 120, standardized as in the frozen study. Each schedule equal weight. Report switch added to constant and neural-only, neural added to constant and switch-only, schedule-wise scores, six/eight-pulse and remaining-eight means, the first 40 minutes, and half-step integration. Relative performance of the previously trained intact network is historical context only.
